workload: oneDAL 2025.0.0 -> 2025.11.0, six matched members, L2 (binary + headers)
caveats: tree_peak_rss_mib is SUMMED RSS across the process tree and double-counts shared pages; it is an upper bound, not the footprint. PSS was not collected.
One run per revision; the wall delta carries unmeasured variance.

The HEAD run was measured with py-spy attached (120 s at 50 Hz) and unrelated benchmark work running concurrently; the base run had the host nearly to itself. Both inflate HEAD's time, so the wall reduction is a conservative reading.
Twelve headers are excluded from BOTH sides; each is unparseable from the published oneDAL package by any tool. See spelling-cache-admission.md's 'Header scope'.
